senses.gloss: (with ב) to be engaged in, to handle.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 113a:3">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>הֲפוֹךְ בנבילתא ולא תֵיפוֹךְ וכ׳</he> deal in carcasses, but deal not in words (gossip, sophistry &c.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:1:5">Y. B. Kam. IV, beg. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>אנא הפך ומתהפך בדידי וכ׳</he> I turn around my stock of goods (selling and buying again), so that I reach thee in profits.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:22">Ab. V, 22</cite> <he>הֲפוֹךְ בה וכ׳</he> study it over and again; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00735"><he>הֲפִיכָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: l) (= h. הֵשִׁיב) to turn; to bring back, restore; to turn off (wrath), to appease; to give in return, reply.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:13">Targ. Prov. XXV, 13</cite>.—
Ib. XXIV, 29 Ms. (ed. אַהֲפֵיךְ Af.).—
Ib. 26.—2) to handle, be engaged in, barter, study (v. Pe. 4).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:6">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>דוה מְהַפֵּיךְ בההיא וכ׳</he> was negotiating about a field.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:1">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה דלא מְהַפִּיכְנָא בזכותיה</he> before I study what might be said in his favor.

Pes. 40ᵃ דמְהַפְּכֵי כיפי who handle sheaves; כי מְהַפְּכִיתוּ הַפִּיכוּ וכ׳ (Ms. M. הפכיתו) when ye handle (them), handle them with the thought that they will be used for a religious purpose.—Part. pass. מְהַפַּךְ. Y. Maasr. III, end, 51ᵃ היא הפכה והיא מְהַפְּכָה it turns and is turned in all directions (studied over and again), but we can learn nothing from it.

senses.gloss: to be turned, changed; to turn about, deal in &c.
